title: The 1999 ILOVEYOU Virus: Myth vs Reality

scenes.text: 1999 saw a virus that hit millions in a single day
Many believe the ILOVEYOU worm was a simple love‑letter email that anyone could open.
scenes.label: It was just a love email
scenes.query: ILOVEYOU email subject love letter myth

scenes.text: In fact, the worm used a Visual Basic script that exploited Outlook’s auto‑run feature, spreading without user interaction once the attachment was opened.
scenes.label: VB script auto‑run exploit
scenes.query: ILOVEYOU Visual Basic script exploit Outlook

scenes.text: Never trust unexpected attachments – they can run code silently.
scenes.label: Attachments can run code

scenes.text: Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: Uncover the real mechanics behind the infamous 1999 ILOVEYOU worm and why the love‑letter story is misleading. Stay safe and stay curious.
